about: The interest tags of the Second-brain notes card. Edit this file, then run build.py --from-copies and build_data.py. A note may carry one to three interests. An interest with no note stays in the list and is drawn dashed: a direction, not a claim. The old tags of each note are kept as its kind.

interests.name: AI agents
interests.what: Agents that act for you: how to run, steer and trust a crew of them.

interests.name: Context engineering
interests.what: What the agent reads, when, and in what order.

interests.name: Skills
interests.what: Small packaged instructions an agent loads when it needs them.

interests.name: Knowledge bases
interests.what: Notes and wikis kept as plain files that AI can read.

interests.name: Inference and cost
interests.what: Picking the model and keeping the token bill small.

interests.name: Security and safety
interests.what: Keeping agents inside limits, and a person in the loop.

interests.name: Dev tooling
interests.what: Tools and pipelines that make agent-written code easier to ship.

interests.name: Evals
interests.what: Checking that agent work is right, by running it.

interests.name: Communication
interests.what: Ways of writing and talking that make AI answers easier to read.

interests.name: Health
interests.what: Using AI in a way that suits how a person's mind works.
